scenes.title: 湖畔のカヌー体験
scenes.titleEn: A Canoe Day by the Lake
scenes.story: At dawn, Maya arrives at the lake for the village canoe day. Wearing a life jacket is the norm here, and the waiting families all follow this sensible custom. A bold visitor launches his canoe through a narrow opening between floating gates. Nearby, a volunteer pumps air into a red marker balloon and watches it swell. Above a string of colourful pennants, a gull begins to soar towards the hills. At the landing stage, twin paddles propel a training canoe forwards, while a separate instructor demonstrates how to steer the safety boat. A grandmother shows her faith in another instructor by calmly handing over her little grandson. At a shore display, a submerged rescue dummy explains how someone can drown without a life jacket. Maya practises until she can overcome her difficulty with the balance beam. A shining trophy promises glory to the eventual winner.

scenes.title: 庭のチャリティーカフェ
scenes.story: The charity café opens on the lawn behind the community centre. A damp cushion, still covered in tiny droplets, reminds the volunteers of last night's rain. Tom returns from an errand carrying a shopping basket, and he places a jar of jam beside the bread. At the washing station, a helper starts to rub a muddy plate with a cloth. Everyone avoids a foul rubbish bin until its lid is closed. The organiser checks the animal feeding corner: no rabbit should starve while the café is busy. On the cake table, a glossy chocolate tart seems to tempt a visitor who is trying to eat less sugar. Beside her, a tailor begins to sew a loose apron strap. A storyteller reads aloud to children under the apple tree. Their parents enjoy a pleasant break in comfortable garden chairs. Finally, three large wooden petals constitute the flower decoration above the entrance.

scenes.title: 美術品トラブルの法廷
scenes.story: A bald judge opens a hearing about a disputed art sale. In the visitors' seats, an anxious buyer squeezes a handkerchief while waiting for her turn. She has decided to sue the dealer who sold her a damaged statue. The buyer says he tried to deceive her by covering a crack with gold foil. A striking striped vase from the same sale stands on a separate display trolley. An inspector explains how someone could overlook damage while concentrating on a statue's shiny face. Unfortunately, the dealer's photograph is vague, with most details blurred. The buyer's adviser uses a pointer to specify the exact split in the statue's base. A new witness raises her hand to swear that she will tell the truth; another is ready to testify from the witness stand. Eventually, the dealer agrees to admit his mistake. The outcome is a full refund, handed over in a small pouch.

scenes.title: 川辺の村祭り
scenes.story: Visitors pay a small toll to cross the wooden bridge into the riverside fair. Inside, a girl waits to discover her fate in a lucky draw, where a blindfolded volunteer selects coloured marbles. Her brother learns to blow enormous soap bubbles beside the path. At the toy stall, a spring-loaded frog seems to scare a curious cat, which arches its back. The organiser takes command of the entrance queue, directing newcomers with a clear sweep of her arm. Nearby, a helper must drag an empty cart across a patch of rough ground. A customer continues to insist on paying for her friend's tea, holding out a coin despite his refusal. Across the path, a craft worker starts to weave a basket. A pushchair gives a low post a gentle bump. Beside an ugly papier-mâché monster, an upset child stares at a dropped ice cream. A volunteer quickly offers a fresh cone.

scenes.title: 嵐の岬の救助
scenes.story: By dusk the little fishing boat was in grave peril off the rocky headland. 'Brace yourselves!' the skipper shouted as a giant wave rose behind them. Minutes later, the old trawler on the rocks was already a wreck, its mast snapped and its hull torn open. A thick bank of sea fog rolled in and obscured the far cliffs. One sailor was clinging to a floating barrel with both arms, while another, desperate and exhausted, thrashed in the water with one hand reaching out. From the shore, a coastguard hurled a lifebuoy on a long rope towards him. Above them, a rescue helicopter hovered as the winchman hoisted a survivor up on a cable. Those who reached the beach began to ascend the steep steps to the lighthouse. At the bottom, a stone hut served as a refuge from the wind, and inside, a volunteer wrapped a blanket round a frightened woman and consoled her: 'Everyone is safe now.'

scenes.title: 骨董商の裁判
scenes.story: A corrupt official hides a purse beneath his desk while a merchant presents two antique cups in the little courtroom. The prosecutor is preparing to indict the dealer over the missing museum collection. Beside her, an elderly customer clasps her hands to plead for the return of her wedding cup. Nobody should presume guilt simply because the accused looks nervous. A clerk must withhold a sealed envelope until the judge permits its release. Meanwhile, a bright purple handprint on the broken cabinet makes the official's involvement manifest. The judge announces the verdict by returning the customer's property and directing the official towards the court officer. Throughout the hearing, a separate museum caretaker maintains her dignity, sitting upright despite the awkward questions. The display cups are identical in shape, but an expert identifies a separate antique with a tiny maker's dent as genuine.

scenes.title: 人形劇の初舞台
scenes.titleEn: Opening Night at the Puppet Theatre
scenes.story: Tonight's satire turns a pompous mayor into a ridiculous dancing puppet. At the front of the stage, an actress prepares to utter the opening greeting with one hand cupped beside her mouth. Behind a low screen, the puppeteer can manipulate a wooden bird using delicate strings. Purple is the predominant colour of the enormous curtain, although a narrow green border remains visible. In the first row, supporters acclaim the young company with enthusiastic applause. A small drummer sits amid a circle of flower pots that decorate the stage. Nearby, a serious usher tries to suppress a smile by pressing her lips together. A sudden paper dragon may frighten a child, so its operator keeps it well away from the seats. One rebel in the chorus wears bright trainers instead of matching shoes. The theatre's silver trophy represents its prestige, while a juvenile performer waits patiently beside a smaller costume rack.

scenes.title: 市場の昼ごはん
scenes.story: At the covered market, a stingy stallholder offers a customer just one tiny crumb of cheese. Across the aisle, a cheerful cook is ready to sprinkle herbs over a bowl of soup. An abandoned loaf looks stale, with a hard crust and curled slices. A customer's greed is obvious as he gathers nearly every peach into his oversized basket. At a separate table, a visitor closes her eyes to savor a spoonful of fragrant stew. The fish stall's strong odor makes another shopper pinch his nose. Behind the bakery counter, a cook begins to fume because somebody has hidden his clean apron. A stack of disposable paper bowls stands beside the serving hatch. Fortunately, a decent grocer gives a hungry visitor a generous sandwich. For a child with an allergy, the assistant must omit the nuts. At the corner table, two intimate friends lean close together over their tea.

scenes.title: 干潟の調査隊
scenes.story: Our expedition reaches the shore before the morning tide turns. A grassy incline leads down from the car park, where a wary volunteer tests a slippery stone with her boot. Low barriers confine visitors to the safe wooden path. Farther out, the waters recede, exposing a shining strip of sand beside the boats. One unused mooring rope hangs slack between two posts. Beyond it stands a wooden hut with a bright blue roof, facing an enormous expanse of open sea. Inside a shallow tray, delicate seedlings may perish without fresh water, so the team carries a watering can. Near the rocks, our guide tells everyone to beware of the wet surface and points out a safer route. Before checking the instruments, I entrust my precious camera to a careful assistant. She places its strap around her neck and promises to keep it dry throughout the survey.

scenes.title: 町の発明展示会
scenes.story: At the invention fair, a curious apparatus transfers water between glass chambers without a pump. Nearby, a rolling marble strikes a domino, making their causal connection easy to see. A kitchen scientist shows how to derive a yellow liquid from fresh lemons. Across the room, a projector can enlarge the image of a beetle onto a blank wall. A carpenter demonstrates perpendicular beams by joining them at a perfect right angle. A young visitor displays remarkable intellect by completing a complicated mechanical puzzle. Her father pauses to ponder two possible bridge models before choosing either. A layperson wearing an ordinary shopping coat looks puzzled beside a specialist's workbench. Another table holds a mediocre clay pot, functional but uneven and unremarkable. The tallest tower of balanced wooden spoons is an astonishing feat. Finally, two separate fountains produce simultaneous spurts when the demonstrator presses a single pedal, delighting everyone gathered around.

scenes.title: 町内運動会の練習

A gymnast takes a gentle tumble onto a thick blue mat, while a separate volunteer starts to stagger under an oversized mascot costume. A weightlifter shows the strain of a heavy practice lift through tense shoulders and a clenched face. At the entrance, a firm official can compel cyclists to wear helmets by keeping the gate closed. Helpers allot a separate basket of equipment to each team. Under a parasol, a coach tries to soothe a tearful beginner with a reassuring hand. scenes.title: 共同菜園の話し合い
scenes.story: A stubborn resident refuses to move his chair from the entrance to the meeting tent. Inside, a stern chairwoman points firmly towards the empty seat beside her. An affluent supporter parks her polished limousine outside and joins the discussion. At the central table, two other representatives shake hands on an accord. A proponent of the garden proudly presents a model with accessible paths and raised beds. The council representative can sanction the project by placing the official seal beside that model. Unfortunately, one gatekeeper's prejudice appears when he welcomes smart shoes but blocks muddy work boots. Most residents reject this unfair treatment, and their view will prevail through an overwhelming show of hands. A solicitor closes the folder for a threatened lawsuit, relieved that agreement now seems possible.

scenes.title: 陶芸教室の発表会
scenes.story: At her first pottery lesson, a little girl reveals an innate talent by shaping a beautifully balanced bowl without help. Across the room, a rude visitor tries to humiliate a beginner by laughing and pointing at his crooked vase. In a tall clay sculpture, a round void creates a surprising view of the garden beyond. A potter lets a blue plate whirl on the wheel while she smooths its edge. The low display stand beside her comprises three wooden sections. On its finest cup, a subtle pink stripe almost disappears into the cream glaze. A student begins to scribble loose decorative loops on scrap paper. Nearby, an assistant uses a square mould to contradict the tutor's mistaken claim about a pot's round base. A squeaky stool starts to annoy another learner. At the entrance, a throng gathers for the exhibition, while a disappointed sculptor lowers his head in despair beside a collapsed clay tower.

scenes.title: 共同庭園の手入れ
scenes.titleEn: A Working Morning in the Shared Garden
scenes.story: In the shared garden, fallen leaves decay in an open compost basket. A forgotten board may deprive a young plant of sunlight, so a volunteer lifts it away. Another gardener decides to abandon a broken trolley beside the tool shed and fetch a working one. A hostile goose hisses from behind its safe fence, while a cat begins to stalk a harmless clockwork mouse near the flower beds. Children flee from the unexpected spray of a sprinkler, laughing as they reach the dry path. For lunch, a pot of vegetable soup will simmer on the outdoor hob. A locked gate can preclude entry to the section where repairs are under way. Beside it, an overfilled watering can tilts so far that a spill is inevitable. One tall helper must stoop beneath a low branch. Meanwhile, the organiser manages to cope with the busy morning by carrying seedlings and watering them in turn.

scenes.title: 小さな博物館の再出発

scenes.story: A discerning visitor seems to despise the cheap imitation crown, turning away with a dismissive curled lip. Nearby, a curator feels sorrow as she looks at a portrait of her much-loved former teacher. An old stone hearth warms the gallery, where a friendly imaginary cat is said to haunt the doorway. At the minerals table, an expert can discriminate between glass beads and precious stones using a small lens. A volunteer learns to exploit a simple pulley to lift a heavy exhibit safely. The uncovered shape of a giant fossil begins to arouse a child's curiosity. At the desk, a new manager will assume responsibility by accepting the museum keys and putting on the curator's coat. A tiny scratch on a plain saucer seems trivial beside the ancient treasures. Through an open arch, a ripple spreads across the courtyard pool. scenes.title: 村のパレードの出発前
scenes.titleEn: Before the Village Parade Sets Off
scenes.story: A driver must maneuver the flower float between two closely spaced gateposts. Behind him, the assembly yard is in turmoil, with dancers searching for costumes and helpers untangling ribbons. One steward finds the endless knot-tying tiresome and yawns over another bundle. A drummer answers the confusion with a broad grin. Near the fence, a balloon begins to diminish as air escapes through its loose neck. A spectator gives a delighted shriek when a surprise paper butterfly springs from a box. Unfortunately, a missing axle is a fatal flaw in the second float's design, so that vehicle cannot join the parade. An impatient adult directs an insult at a slow helper by sticking out his tongue. The mascot tries to evade a photographer by stepping behind a pillar. A collector's obsession is visible in his trolley overflowing with toy ducks. At the exit, a young bully blocks a smaller child's path until a supervisor approaches.

words.ja: 【n】策略、巧みな動き /【v】~を巧みに操作する
words.role: 狭い門を巧みに通る運転手
words.hook: manu（手で）＋operari（働く）＝手で操作する。operate と同根。maneuver a vehicle＝巧みに動かす。

words.role: リボンと人が入り乱れる混乱
words.hook: in turmoil＝混乱状態で。人も物もまとまらず動き回る広場。

words.ja: うんざりさせる、退屈な
words.role: 結び直しにうんざりする係員
words.hook: a tiresome task＝うんざりする作業。単に疲れたのでなく繰り返しが退屈。

words.hook: a shriek of delight＝喜びの甲高い声。恐怖だけでなく驚きと歓喜にも使う。

words.hook: a bully＝弱い相手を威圧する人。insultは侮辱の行為、こちらは行う人物。

scenes.title: 厨房の抜き打ち点検
scenes.story: The chief inspector has a grave expression as she studies the restaurant kitchen. A guest's antipathy towards olives is apparent from the way he pushes the bowl far away. Two inspectors arrive together for a surprise raid on an unlicensed food store beside the pantry; everyone cooperates calmly. At the baking bench, a chef uses sarcasm, praising a burnt tart while rolling her eyes. From floury fingerprints leading towards the biscuit tin, an assistant can infer what happened earlier. A child attempts to sneak past the doorway on tiptoe. Another helper will alter the oversized tablecloth by pinning its hem higher. A waiter gives a gasp when an unexpectedly tall cake emerges from the cupboard. At the sink, water starts to surge from a newly opened tap. An uncovered bin begins to stink in the warm air. Finally, the head cook will precede the trainees through the dining-room door to demonstrate the proper serving route.

words.role: 深刻な顔の点検責任者
words.hook: gravis（重い）由来。gravity と同根。墓のgraveとは別語。a grave expression＝深刻な表情。

words.hook: anti-（反対）＋pathy（感情）。sympathy の逆。antipathy towards＝〜への強い反感。

The bin stinks＝ごみ箱が臭う。主語そのものが悪臭を放つ動詞。

scenes.title: 屋根裏の修復教室
scenes.story: In retrospect, the museum should have opened its attic to visitors years ago. Today, a conservator measures the breadth of an old picture frame while a student uses a lens to magnify its damaged corner. A brittle fragment of plaster rests alone on a padded tray, safely beyond curious fingers. At another table, an artist will depict the original house using only charcoal and careful observation. A crimson curtain provides a cheerful patch of colour behind her. Nearby, a metalworker examines a dent in a copper jug and compares it with a crude wooden copy made by a beginner. Nobody expects perfect work immediately, so the tutor encourages questions. Under a bright lamp, a researcher studies a minute crack in a porcelain cup. Finally, a volunteer brushes rust from an iron hinge, revealing how patience can rescue objects that once seemed useless.

magnus（大きい）＋-fy（する）＝拡大する。magnitude と同根。magnify a detail＝細部を拡大する。
硬くてもぽろっと割れる。柔らかいsoftとは違う弱さ。
de-（すっかり）＋pict（描く）＝描き出す。picture と同根。depict a scene＝場面を描写する。

鉄の表面の赤茶色がrust。磨くと地金が現れる。

scenes.title: 町の模擬法廷
scenes.story: The attorney arrives early for the community's mock trial and arranges her papers without rushing. Opposite her, a jury of local volunteers settles on a wooden bench. A mock judge explains what it means to convict a fictional shopkeeper of taking a customer's bicycle. A spectator's indifference is obvious as he studies his nails instead of the evidence. The organiser confirms that the customer is the legitimate owner, pointing to a matching key and lock. A volunteer speaks on behalf of the absent customer, holding her photograph beside him. When legal jargon confuses a young observer, the tutor explains it quietly. Two visiting students then deliberate around a separate table. Two photographs correspond exactly, but another issue remains pending in an untouched folder. Throughout the discussion, the chair maintains her composure, breathing slowly and keeping her hands relaxed. Everyone leaves with a better understanding of careful judgement.

words.hook: attorney＝主に米国の弁護士。英国ではsolicitor（事務弁護士）やbarrister（法廷弁護士）が相当。
jurare（誓う）由来＝宣誓した判定団。juryは判断する人の集団。裁判官一人とは違う。

words.hook: con-（すっかり）＋vict（打ち負かす）＝有罪と証明する。victory と同根。非難condemnと区別。

com-（共に）＋pose（置く）＝心を整えて置く。compose の名詞。keep one's composure＝平静を保つ。

scenes.title: 村の予算会議
scenes.story: A considerable pile of repair requests awaits the village committee when its members convene in the hall. Their interim chair wears a borrowed ceremonial ribbon because the usual chair is away. Together they must devise a way to reopen the playground before summer. Materials are scarce, as the nearly empty timber shelf behind them demonstrates. The treasurer illustrates the deficit with an empty purse beside a pile of unpaid invoices. A local builder makes a pledge to donate several hours of work, placing his hand over his heart. Beside him, a thrifty resident carefully sorts reusable screws into small dishes. One younger member proposes a radical change: replace the broken climbing frame with a shared garden. A salesman tries to flatter the chair by admiring her ribbon extravagantly. Another member responds with scorn, turning up his nose, but the chair asks everyone to compare the proposals fairly.

words.hook: considerable amount＝かなりの量。無視できない大きな山。
con-（共に）＋vene（来る）＝集まらせる。convention と同根。convene a meeting＝会議を招集する。
inter（間）由来＝その間の。interim chair＝暫定議長。正式担当が戻るまでの代役。

words.hook: devise a plan＝計画を考案する。部品を組んで解決法を作る。
scarce resources＝乏しい資源。必要な棚に一本しかない。

words.hook: de-（離れて）＋facere（なす）＝足りない。deficient と同根。収入より支出が大きい不足。

scorn＝見下す軽蔑。怒鳴るのでなく鼻であしらう表情。

scenes.title: 人形劇のリハーサル
scenes.story: Backstage, the prompter can only mutter because the audience is already entering the hall. A small puppet monkey causes mischief by hiding the director's spectacles beneath a cushion. On the miniature stage, a fairy prepares to slay a dragon with a harmless ribbon of magical light. The story reminds every mortal that courage matters more than size. A large shadow is meant to terrify a trembling puppet rabbit, although the real children are laughing. An actor adjusts his disguise of false whiskers beside a mirror. Above him hangs a curled black paper cloud representing a witch's curse. A horrific cardboard monster waits in a separate corner, all enormous eyes and ridiculous teeth. A model battlefield represents warfare without showing any fighting. Finally, a princess puppet held hostage behind a toy gate reaches towards a friendly giant, whose offered ladder promises salvation. The rehearsal ends in delighted applause.

words.ja: ぼそぼそ言う、つぶやく
words.role: 小声でつぶやく進行係
words.hook: mutter＝口の中でぼそぼそ言う。大声で読むのとは逆。
make mischief＝いたずらをする。困らせるが深刻な害はない。

words.role: 魔法で竜を倒す妖精人形
words.hook: slay a dragon＝竜を退治する。物語ではkillより勇壮な語。

words.role: 砂時計の横の人間人形
words.hook: mors（死）由来。immortal と同根。mortal＝いつか死ぬ人間。永遠の妖精と違い時間に限りがある。

words.hook: terrere（怖がらせる）＋-fy（する）。terror と同根。terrify＝強い恐怖を与える。

warfare＝戦闘・戦争という活動。ここでは無人の陣地で示す。

scenes.title: 保育園の庭づくり
scenes.story: The nursery invites families to nurture seedlings in its little garden. A vulnerable young plant bends beneath a sudden breeze, so its small pot receives a protective screen. At the gate, a father tries to discourage his daughter from climbing the slippery wall. A thoughtless visitor begins to harass a busy helper with repeated taps on her shoulder, and the manager politely asks him to wait. Meanwhile, another child shows compassion by carrying water to a stray kitten sheltering beneath a bench. A plump robin watches from the fence, hoping someone will uncover a worm. In the sunny border, healthy beans flourish above their supports. Water can seep through a crack in the old watering barrel, leaving a thin wet trail on the paving. Beside the herbs, a gardener pauses to inhale their fresh scent. A timid newcomer finally steps out from behind his mother's coat to join the planting.

words.ja: 【v】~を育てる、~を養育する /【n】養育、育ち
words.role: 苗を大切に育てる保育士

words.hook: dis-（奪う）＋courage（勇気）＝気をくじく。discourage A from doing＝Aを思いとどまらせる。

words.hook: harass＝繰り返し困らせる。忙しい相手にしつこく接触する。
com-（共に）＋passion（苦しみ）＝苦しみを共にする。show compassion＝思いやりを示す。

scenes.title: 雪の駅で足止め
scenes.story: A transient visitor with a small suitcase waits beneath the station canopy, hoping to continue his journey soon. A patient commuter can tolerate the cold, standing calmly in a thick coat while others complain. Packed snow may inhibit the movement of a separate set of points, and an engineer kneels to clear it. Nearby, a child starts to tremble, so her mother offers another scarf. An artist chooses to gaze at the snowy hills rather than worry. The stationmaster can foresee further trouble from the dark clouds approaching the valley. A repair crew must prolong the closure by keeping a red barrier across the platform entrance. One passenger scratches an itchy wrist beneath a woollen sleeve; another turns aside to sneeze into a tissue. An unattended parcel rests safely on a trolley. Even after the next train arrives, an elderly couple linger beside the tea stall, enjoying their unexpected conversation.

words.role: 通過途中の短期滞在客
words.hook: trans-（越えて）＋ire（行く）＝通り過ぎていく。transit と同根。a transient visitor＝一時滞在の客。
tolerate the cold＝寒さに耐える。嫌でも落ち着いて受け入れる。

words.role: 分岐装置を妨げる固い雪
words.hook: in-（中に）＋hibit（保つ）＝押しとどめる。exhibit と同根。inhibit movement＝動きを抑える。
tremere（震える）由来。tremendous と同根。tremble with cold＝寒さで震える。

words.role: 雪山をじっと見る画家
words.hook: gaze at＝じっと見つめる。一瞬のglanceより長い視線。

scenes.title: 村祭りのケーキ審査
scenes.titleEn: Cake Judging at the Village Fair
scenes.story: The dropped cherry seems a trifle to the baker, although her contrary neighbour insists it ruins the whole display. At the next stall, a confident competitor begins to boast about his enormous sponge cake. Behind them, a musician will pound a large drum to announce the judging. One judge makes a superficial inspection, glancing only at the icing before moving on. When the neighbour complains again, the baker's assistant offers a cheerful retort and points to his own crooked tart. A burst balloon can startle the dog beside their table, but its owner quickly settles it. Meanwhile, two friends stroll between the stalls with their hands behind their backs. A mouldy sandwich inspires disgust in a visitor who wrinkles her nose. Another competitor displays aggression by leaning forward with clenched fists during an argument. scenes.title: 港の清掃作戦
scenes.story: The old harbor is busy with volunteers rather than fishing boats this morning. A caretaker organises the disposal of broken baskets beside the collection lorry. Under a canopy, a small machine can shred damaged cardboard into tidy strips. Empty bottles accumulate in a transparent collection cage nearby. From the jetty, a fisherman raises his arm to hail the approaching supply boat. Oil on a wheel may impair a trolley's grip, so its owner wipes the tyre carefully. scenes.title: 平和博物館の追悼室

scenes.story: News of the donor's decease has brought old friends to the peace museum, where his empty chair stands beside a portrait. A small electric flame represents their hope for eternal peace. Across the room, visitors place flowers at a memorial to a massacre; the display shows only empty shoes and peaceful candles. A former official's lowered portrait recalls a public disgrace without inviting visitors to mock him. His granddaughter will inherit the modest collection of paintings, and she holds the key to its storage cupboard. At the outset, the guide asks everyone to listen respectfully. A sensible visitor switches her telephone off before approaching the central display. A painting of a seaside resort recalls the peaceful holidays he loved. The dim side alcove encourages reflection. A volunteer will affirm the museum's commitment to peace by placing an open hand above a white dove sculpture. Another guide rejects a proposed sensational display outright, pushing its closed folder away.

scenes.title: 公園で防災訓練

scenes.story: At the verge of the park, a safety instructor welcomes families to a calm outdoor drill. Nearby, a young athlete can leap over a low foam hurdle without difficulty. Visitors heed a marshal's raised palm and stop before a loose cable that might impede their progress. A rational organiser compares the risks and chooses a safer route using a simple model. The noisy demonstration bell will cease when another volunteer releases its handle. scenes.title: キャンプ場の小さな騒動

scenes.title: 埠頭の公開調停
scenes.titleEn: A Public Hearing on the Wharf
scenes.story: A temporary hearing opens beside the wharf, where fishing boats rest against thick mooring ropes. The plaintiff, a small stallholder, presents a damaged tray and asks for compensation. A harbour inspector points at an overflowing rubbish bin to condemn the careless dumping nearby. The mediator remains impartial, placing equal piles of speaking tokens before both parties. A volunteer readily offers a spare chair without waiting to be asked. Some traders resent a wealthy owner's private barrier across their shared walkway. Their coalition brings together fish sellers and boat repairers, who link arms despite their different work clothes. Beyond them, an obvious injustice leaves one wheelchair user blocked while other visitors pass freely. A legal officer prepares to prosecute the company responsible if the obstruction continues. Two spectators mock the stallholder with exaggerated gestures, but an indifferent tourist ignores the whole discussion and studies a shell instead. The mediator calls everyone back to practical solutions.

scenes.title: 山の宿から朝の散歩
scenes.titleEn: A Morning Walk from the Mountain Lodge
scenes.story: At the mountain lodge, one visitor admits that he begins every unfamiliar walk with dread, gripping his rucksack straps tightly. Near the entrance, loose stones make another walker stumble, although her companion catches her elbow. A waxed jacket can repel water during the guide's quick demonstration. Across the valley, a fabulous waterfall glows in the morning light. Nobody wants to intrude on the quiet picnic of a couple beside the path. Ferns thrive in a sheltered patch behind their bench. A young climber asks a peer of the same age to check his bootlaces. His old flask is apt to leak, so a little water escapes from its lid. Further uphill, a broad cave offers shade. Dry leaves swirl around a separate stone hollow. Above the distant ridge, a dark cloud seems an omen of afternoon rain, encouraging the group to finish early.

scenes.title: 地域アトリエの壁画公開
scenes.story: A pushy organiser tries to intimidate a new volunteer by standing much too close with his chest puffed out. Nearby, a queer artist proudly carries a rainbow fan to the community mural opening. The neighbourhood's notorious paint spiller arrives with splashes all over his trousers, and several residents protect their clean shoes. Two decorators toil over a heavy bucket of plaster while a late guest drops a glove in his haste. On the small stage, a dancer moves with grace, balancing smoothly on one foot. A teacher uses colourful shapes to stimulate a child's curiosity. At a quiet table, an elderly visitor finds profound meaning in a photograph of several generations holding hands. The old ticket booth is deserted, its window empty. The mural's orange circle is distinct from its blue square. Finally, a restorer handles a delicate paper lantern with the utmost care before hanging it above the gathering.

scenes.title: 渡り鳥公園の遠足
scenes.titleEn: An Outing to the Waterbird Park
scenes.story: A horrible sandwich, green at the edges, ruins one visitor's picnic at the waterbird park. His attempt to push through a firmly locked gate is futile, so he puts his lunch away. Above the lake, geese migrate in a long formation towards warmer country. A ranger uses a welcoming gesture to urge the visitors towards an open path. Near the picnic benches, disorder appears as a jumble of fallen baskets and tangled straps. One cheeky pupil tries to defy the boundary rope by stepping over it. At a demonstration pool, a moving wooden duck can delude real ducks into following it. A separate feeding bowl is devoid of food. Beside the cottage, a camper kneels to compress a sleeping bag into a tiny sack. The schoolchildren conform to their teacher's arrangement, standing neatly in matching hats. Swallows reside in a nest beneath the cottage roof, safely above everyone's reach.

scenes.title: 農園組合の見学会

scenes.story: At the farm co-operative's open day, a mechanic uses a pump to expel muddy water from a blocked pipe. At a separate kitchen table, onions make a cook weep into her handkerchief. An impatient buyer taps his foot beside an empty vegetable crate. Two neighbouring seed trays show only a marginal difference in growth. An apple tree covered in blossom offers the prospect of an excellent autumn harvest. A child is preoccupied with a ladybird and misses the tractor demonstration. Nearby, a wheelbarrow rests on the brink of a shallow pond. A breach in the fence allows a curious lamb to visit the herb beds. One visitor points at a goat to allege that it ate his flowers, although he has no evidence. Another finally decides to succumb to temptation and takes a slice of cake. At the design bench, a young farmer begins to conceive a new shelter by arranging a tiny cardboard roof over toy animals.

scenes.title: 乗馬クラブの小さな騒動
scenes.titleEn: Small Surprises at the Riding Club
scenes.story: At the riding club, a beginner holds one rein loosely while a quiet pony waits beside her. A puddle reflects the stable roof after the morning shower. Further along the practice lane, a low wooden obstacle gives another pony an easy jumping exercise. A nervous horse starts to retreat from a flapping tarpaulin, so its rider gives it space. Two helpers show mutual support by steadying opposite ends of a heavy mounting block. Near the picnic table, a girl tries to tease her dog by hiding a biscuit behind her back. An instructor raises a firm hand to assert her right to keep the riding lane clear. A frantic parent searches an open bag for a missing car key. Paper litter collects beside a bin. On a whim, a visitor buys a ridiculous feathery hat. His friend's irrational fear of a tiny toy spider makes her climb onto a perfectly safe bench.

scenes.title: 蒸気機関の博物館
scenes.story: A troop of scouts enters the steam engine museum in an orderly group. At the entrance, a careless adult begins to abuse a delicate ticket lever by leaning his whole weight on it. Beyond him, a small visitor watches a huge polished engine in awe. Through the windows, the old brick chimney rises above the roof. An engineer uses a gauge to assess the condition of a separate wheel axle. On a nearby bench, a visitor pauses to contemplate two possible routes around a model railway. A guide makes the gear mechanism intelligible by turning a large demonstration wheel slowly while a child nods in understanding. Another child tries to interfere with the moving display by reaching over its low guard, and a volunteer gently stops him. Upstairs, a climber hopes to attain the observation platform and is just taking the final step. Down below, an idle lathe waits with its drive belt hanging loose.

scenes.title: 港の事務所の引っ越し
scenes.titleEn: Moving Day at the Harbour Office
scenes.story: A child feels terror when a huge sea-monster costume appears at the harbour office, although its wearer waves kindly from a distance. A somber usher in a dark grey suit prepares the farewell gathering nearby. On a packing table, an old music player can eject a disc with a gentle spring. A sane porter chooses the smooth ramp instead of balancing a trolley on the steps. After repeated administrative mistakes, the company must demote a supervisor; the director removes his ornate shoulder badge. At the refreshment stand, a small pinch of salt represents the advised intake for one meal. The office move brings upheaval, with drawers and packing boxes scattered everywhere. A new storage cabinet will displace a battered old cupboard, which workers slide aside. Beyond the quay, a majestic sailing ship fills the sky. At a separate bench, a resident pauses to mourn the harbour's old dog beside its framed photograph and a single lily.

scenes.story: After feeling faint in the heat, a pupil is fully conscious again, sitting upright and answering the school nurse. Nearby, an infamous snail rests beside several badly nibbled leaves. Gardeners must segregate unhealthy plants, so a worker places a brown-leafed seedling behind a small mesh screen. Touching a sensitive plant can provoke its leaves to close; a child tests this gently with a straw. An enormous sunflower seems to stun another visitor, who freezes with her mouth open. A tangled irrigation hose can perplex a beginner, who scratches his head over its loops. A caretaker pulls a heavy water barrel with all his might. On the demonstration table, a potato and a set of smooth stones have equivalent weight on balanced scales. The teacher will dismiss the class with a wave when watering ends. scenes.title: 農家の1年
scenes.story: On Hill Farm, the year begins in early spring. Tom hitches his old horse to the plow and turns over the heavy soil in the long field. A week later, his daughter Amy walks along the furrows and sows the seeds by hand. Soon, rows of tiny green seedlings push up through the earth. The summer is dry, so Tom opens the narrow irrigation channel, and cool water runs between the rows. By July, the wheat stands tall and golden, and beside it the barley bends in the wind, its long whiskers shining in the sun. When the grain is ripe, the whole family comes out to reap it with sickles. Across the lane, apples hang heavy in the orchard, and grapes darken on the vines of the little vineyard. The cows spend their days grazing in the meadow. In autumn, grass from the meadow is cut, dried and stored as hay in the big red barn, to feed the animals through the winter. The leftover stalks of the wheat are tied into bales of straw, which make warm beds for the cows.

scenes.title: 錬金術師の工房

By carefully melting these different elements together in a red-hot clay crucible, he creates a strong new alloy. He then pours the bubbling, molten mixture into a carved stone mould to cast a beautiful, golden-yellow brass candlestick, hoping he has finally discovered the secret of the philosopher's stone.
